# BSA Strategic Plan

## Pursuing Excellence Together

The BSA’s professionals and volunteers — and their passions for the aims and
goals of Scouting — are our greatest resources.

### Key Categories for Growth

  * **Membership –**  Our goal is to expand Scouting programs to our nation’s youth.

  * **People –**  Our organization is a reflection of the communities we serve.

  * **Culture –  **We recognize that people are our greatest resource – we are united in our passion for the Scouting program.

  * **IT infrastructure –**** ** We must leverage technology to enable growth.

  * **Finance –**  We must maintain the financial health of the organization.

  * **High Adventure properties –  **We must communicate to local councils the life-changing activities available at our High-Adventure bases that cannot be experienced anyplace else.

### Sample Strategic Plans

The BSA does not have a standard template for a strategic plan. Some councils
continue to use the plan created by OnStrategy, while others have developed
their own. The samples below are from different councils that you may use as a
guide to assist you with the development of your strategic plan. If you have
any questions, please contact the [Council Management
Support](https://www.scouting.org/council-support/council-management-
support/contacts/) team.
